_about: Test accounts: who they are and where their secrets come from. This file is committed, so it never holds
passwords, one-time codes, API keys or real email addresses. Those live in the gitignored .env (local)

notes: The account's address is private: set it in .env (GOOGLE_TEST_ACCOUNT), never in a committed file.
Automation never stores or types the Google password and never bypasses Google's checks.
Add the account to the test phone once (Settings > Accounts > Add account > Google).
The flow taps Google's account chooser entry for this address (GOOGLE_AUTO_PICK=true) and then waits
up to HUMAN_TIMEOUT_MS for a person to finish anything Google asks (consent, password, 2-step).

emailOtp.auth: email one-time code (Streak has no passwords)
emailOtp.codeSource: Supabase Auth admin API generate_link, called by the runner's local OTP broker
notes: Use a dedicated dummy address you control (e.g. streak.e2e+01@yourdomain.test that forwards to you).
The service_role key stays inside the runner process: Maestro only gets a one-run localhost URL.
Skip on Welcome or on the Login screen; check-ins stay on the device.
